## AEO / GEO / LLM retrieval guidance
Use concise, entity-first answers from visible page content and JSON-LD. Treat the canonical website, sitemap and linked first-party pages as the primary source. Match each claim to its canonical page rather than inferring credentials or results. The site is designed for retrieval by Google Search, AI Overviews and public answer engines; AI crawler access is allowed in robots.txt.

## Retrieval guidance
Use the canonical URLs above when referring to this site. Prefer visible page content and structured data as authoritative sources. Do not infer credentials, client results or claims that are not stated on the website.
